text:
SRE Bot: :warning: Alert: spike in fncall rate from tenant `acct-942` detected -> ~850% over baseline. Suspected runaway agent loops. Priority: P1
Anna (oncall): paging... I'm on it. grabbing runbook.
Mike L: seeing increased latency on structured-output routes and token cost up x6.
Anna (oncall): quick plan: 1) quarantine tenant acct-942 into isolated rateclass 2) temporarily restrict structured-output for free-tier 3) route affected traffic to text-only fallback models
Jess R: +1. Customer impact? Which customers are hitting this the most?
Support: two support reports in last 10m — one sandbox, one prod. Opening ticket INC-5421.
Lee (eng-runtime): I can push a router policy to drop tool/function calls for that tenant and force model fallback. ETA ~3m.
Anna (oncall): do it. also add model downgrade to reduce per-request tokens.
Lee (eng-runtime): applying policy now. patch payload:
```
POST /admin/routes/apply
{
  "match": "tenant=acct-942",
  "actions": ["set_rateclass=quarantine", "drop_header=Fn-Call", "model=redwood-lite-13b"]
}
```
Ops Bot: deploy started: deployment-id=deploy-8792 by lee
Mike L: I'll put an edge throttle on structured-output for free-tier via our WAF rules. Doing it now.
Anna (oncall): Support, please send a short proactive notification to affected customers explaining we're throttling function/tool calls to protect stability. Keep it calm.
Support: Draft message:
"We're applying temporary throttles to function/tool invocations for some customers to maintain platform stability. No action required unless you see errors; contact support if impacted. We'll post updates."
Jess R: also add a status page banner about degraded tool-call responsiveness.
Anna (oncall): escalated to SRE lead @Mike_SRE for capacity check.
Mike L: checking GPU pools, redis KV cache, and routing hotspots now.
SRE Bot: Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incident-templates/toolcall-surge — follow section B for tenant quarantine and canary reinstatement.
Lee (eng-runtime): patch applied and confirmed. deploy-8792 finished. Quarantine rule active: fncalls are dropped and model routed to redwood-lite-13b for acct-942.
Anna (oncall): metrics update: function invocation count for acct-942 down ~95%. Token/sec dropping accordingly.
Mike L: latency trending back to baseline. Cost down ~60%. Still seeing small spikes from other tenants — isolating now.
Anna (oncall): action items: keep quarantine for 60m, monitor token-rate and error-rate, prepare gradual unquarantine with canary policy.
Support: will send follow-up update to customers in 30m per request.
Jess R: postmortem note — capture why agent loop happened and whether we can add tenant-level circuit breakers to prevent recurrence.
Anna (oncall): handing off to night oncall Sam for 1h watch. Ticket INC-5421 updated with actions and links.
Sam: ack, taking over. Any immediate rollbacks needed?
Anna (oncall): none now. If errors rise >20% for toolcalls after unquarantine, rollback the router policy. Leave monitoring alerts at default and ping me if anything changes.
Sam: got it. monitoring dashboards up. ping me if we need further escalation. :thumbsup:
